image_description: A close-up, eye-level shot of a May Day celebration featuring a maypole. The central pole is partially obscured by numerous colorful ribbons (streamers) in red, orange, green, blue, and white that cascade from the top towards the ground. A crowd of people, including children and adults, are gathered around the base, holding the streamers. The background shows trees and wooden structures, suggesting an outdoor festival setting.
